decisive_finding.reproduction: After initial mediation against physical root R, the reviewer renamed R aside, created a different directory at the exact same R pathname, moved the original authority subtree into the replacement so authority-leaf identities remained stable, and final mediation accepted the unchanged candidate and root pathname.
decisive_finding.cause: Canonical repository identity bound the absolute resolved pathname but not the opened root directory object, and the existing root-swap control changed the pathname rather than replacing the object at the same name.

required_correction: open the canonical root descriptor-first without following links and require a directory object
bind root device and inode identity during initial semantic validation and token mint
retain or reopen and revalidate the exact root directory object at final mediation before authorization consumption
reject same-path rename-and-replace while consuming no approval receipt or token authority
add a causal control that preserves the original authority-leaf identities across the root replacement
root_disposition: The proposal remains non-authoritative and under REWORK. Canonical path identity is insufficient for workspace-effect mediation; equivalent durable root-object enforcement remains required before adoption.
no_claim_statement: This REWORK decision authorizes no external effect and changes no adopted contract, product behavior, claim ceiling, readiness, release, node closure, or goal-completion state.
